title: What will Donald Trump say during Midterm Rally in Greenville, North Carolina originally scheduled for October 20, 2026? Deport / Deported / Deportation
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Deport / Deported / Deportation as part of Midterm Rally in Greenville, North Carolina originally scheduled for October 20, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the Midterm Rally in Greenville, North Carolina originally scheduled for October 20, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the Midterm Rally in Greenville, North Carolina originally scheduled for October 20, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: The Greenville rally is happening as scheduled on Oct 20, 2026, with a live broadcast. Immigration has been central to Trump's midterm rallies, and crowds have chanted 'deport' (e.g., Youngstown, Oct 12), and he often brags about 'the largest deportation' program. However, in the Youngstown excerpt he answered the chant with 'get them the hell out' instead of saying the word, and only his own words count, so it's likely but far from certain.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript of the Greenville speech showing Trump never said 'deport,' 'deported,' or 'deportation' (e.g., he talked about immigration only as 'removing criminals' or 'getting them out'), or the rally being cancelled.

final.reasoning: The low price suggests Trump rarely uses the word lately, or the speech is already underway without it. My evidence was thin (he dodged the word in Youngstown), so I'm moving most of the way toward the market and passing.
